title.rendered: Be Filled With the Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Be filled with the Spirit. Not once. Continually. The Spirit who came at conversion is the same Spirit who fills you fresh each morning, if you will let Him.

content.rendered:
Be filled with the Spirit. Not once. Continually. The Spirit who came at conversion is the same Spirit who fills you fresh each morning, if you will let Him.

The Gospel For Today | Friday, June 5, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to debauchery. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.”
Ephesians 5:18 (NIV)

Today’s Message

Paul puts two pictures next to each other. Drunk on wine. Filled with the Spirit. They are not the same thing, but they share something. Both involve a person being filled with something outside themselves that ends up shaping their behaviour. The question is not whether you will be filled. The question is what you will be filled with.

The Greek verb Paul uses for be filled is present tense, passive voice, imperative mood. It is a command that is also a continuous experience. You could translate it: keep on being filled with the Spirit. This is not a once-for-all event. The Spirit came in at conversion and never leaves. That is settled. But the fullness of the Spirit, the daily, ongoing yielding of every part of you to His leadership, is a fresh experience every morning. Yesterday’s filling is not today’s filling. The Spirit is the same. The cup is the one we keep bringing back.

And how does someone get filled with the Spirit? Paul does not leave it abstract. The verses that follow describe what a Spirit-filled life looks like. Speaking to one another in psalms, hymns and spiritual songs. Singing and making music from the heart to the Lord. Always giving thanks for everything. Submitting to one another out of reverence for Christ. The Spirit-filled life is not exotic. It is ordinary worship, ordinary thanks, ordinary love, ordinary humility, lived deliberately and continually.

The wine that the world reaches for promises to make life bearable for an evening and leaves it heavier in the morning. The Spirit makes life bearable forever and leaves you lighter than you started. The substance you are filled with becomes the life you live.

So today, simply ask. Holy Spirit, fill me. Fill me with Yourself. Fill the cup the worries emptied. Fill the cup the disappointments drained. Fill the cup that yesterday’s busyness left dry. And then keep walking, knowing that the One who came in at conversion is the One filling you right now.

Prayer

Holy Spirit, fill me afresh today. Fill the empty places. Fill the tired places. Fill the parts of me that have been running on fumes. I yield every room of my life to Your leadership. Make me a Spirit-filled person not in spectacle but in steady, daily ordinary obedience. Let the song from my heart this morning be the start of a Spirit-filled day. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I am filled with the Holy Spirit. He fills me continually. I yield every part of my life to Him, today and every day. My ordinary moments become Spirit-filled moments because the Spirit who lives in me fills me afresh whenever I ask.
